verdict.rationale: Productboard's API docs explicitly support associating feedback with users and companies, with dedicated endpoints to create, list, and delete these relationships. Feedback records also carry customer attribution, and the MCP server can create users, companies, and feedback. The evidence is API-centric, though, and does not show how a PM does this linking directly in the product UI. missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-app (UI) linking of feedback to customers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
